evidence.quote: The deal underscores a broader ‌shift as tech giants increasingly tap debt and equity markets to fund AI infrastructure, with ​spending set to top $700 billion this year.
evidence.one_line: 路透社称，科技巨头通过债务和股权市场为AI基础设施融资的趋势扩大，相关支出预计在2026年超过7000亿美元。
evidence.speaker: Reuters

evidence.quote: The Ohio facility could cost over $500 billion and would be the largest data-center project announced to date, according to the Journal.
evidence.one_line: 《华尔街日报》报道称，俄亥俄州数据中心项目成本可能超过 5000 亿美元。
evidence.speaker: MarketWatch（转述《华尔街日报》报道）

evidence.quote: As spending on AI infrastructure continues to accelerate, investors are increasingly focused on whether those investments will produce meaningful financial returns.
evidence.one_line: Calcalist Tech称，AI基础设施支出仍在加速，投资者更关注这些投资能否产生有意义的财务回报。
evidence.speaker: calcalist.com（Shir Reiter）

evidence.quote: Last week, Alphabet raised its 2026 capital expenditure forecast, and investors expect other technology giants to follow suit.
evidence.one_line: Calcalist Tech报道，Alphabet上周提高了2026年资本开支预测，投资者预计其他科技巨头也会跟进。
evidence.speaker: calcalist.com（Shir Reiter）

evidence.quote: Concerns intensified after the Wall Street Journal reported that Nvidia is in talks to provide $250 billion in financing to OpenAI as part of a data center project in Ohio.
evidence.one_line: Calcalist Tech转述《华尔街日报》报道，Nvidia正洽谈为OpenAI俄亥俄州数据中心项目提供2500亿美元融资。
evidence.speaker: calcalist.com（Shir Reiter）

members.question: 科技巨头的AI基础设施投资能否让2026年相关支出达到相应区间？

evidence.quote: The deal underscores a broader ‌shift as tech giants increasingly tap debt and equity markets to fund AI infrastructure, with ​spending set to top $700 billion this year.
The Ohio facility could cost over $500 billion and would be the largest data-center project announced to date, according to the Journal.
As spending on AI infrastructure continues to accelerate, investors are increasingly focused on whether those investments will produce meaningful financial returns.
Last week, Alphabet raised its 2026 capital expenditure forecast, and investors expect other technology giants to follow suit.
Concerns intensified after the Wall Street Journal reported that Nvidia is in talks to provide $250 billion in financing to OpenAI as part of a data center project in Ohio.
